name: CYBERQUEST VR
summary:
Help Equipo Cóndor prepare for their school fair while practising everyday digital safety. C1PHER guides you through three missions: identify suspicious emails, choose and build passwords, and protect the information shared on social media. Practise with explanations, make your own decisions in the challenge and review your results.

Visit Nexo Orbital for an optional arcade challenge: cut threats, let safe items pass and try to survive as the pace increases.

The game and voice guidance are in Spanish. Set
